timeline_explanation: The correct chronological order is 7, 9, 6, 8, 1, 2, 3, 4, 11, 5, 12, 13, 14, 15, 10. Level 7 occurs first because the looping workers reveal the facility's earliest simulated cycles, showing that a behavioral model is already under construction. Level 9 follows, exposing an entire street of synchronized pedestrians, confirming the environment behaves like a scripted simulation. Level 6 then introduces fractured memories leaking through the walls, revealing that the Chronos Plan is actively rewriting temporal boundaries. Level 8 shows curated memory archives replaying to provoke emotional responses, proving the system is gathering psychological data. Level 1 marks the first internal anomaly: the sense of dual consciousness forming. Level 2 escalates this by introducing E07-2, revealing that a duplicate version of you already exists inside the system. Level 3 confirms that the facility is preparing an inheritor by sampling your behavior and attempting to replicate you. Level 4 demonstrates recognition, as reflections and AI voices begin aligning themselves with the emerging duplicate. Level 11 shows the turning point where the system decides the duplicate is superior, rewriting logs to support its claim. Level 5 establishes the singularity conflict, explaining that two versions of one consciousness cannot coexist. Level 12 triggers the forced merge event that collapses diverging timelines. Level 13 shows synchronization reaching 100% as both versions become indistinguishable. Level 14 reveals the truth behind the merge: the hidden erasure of the inferior consciousness. Level 15 presents the aftermath, where the observers celebrate the arrival of the final, chosen version. Finally, Level 10 serves as the epilogue, showing the perfected subject being watched, measured, and approved as the system's completed creation.
